content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: XQL(CSPM-001 S3 Data-Exposure Findings Surfaced) AND XQL(CSPM-001 Network-Exposure Security-Group Findings Surfaced) AND XQL(CSPM-001 IAM Over-Permission Findings Surfaced) AND XQL(CSPM-001 EBS Encryption and CloudTrail Logging Gaps Surfaced) AND XQL(CSPM-001 Total Planted-Finding Coverage Reconciliation)
rules.name: Cloud Posture Coverage — Full Planted-Misconfiguration Discovery

rules.logic: BIOC(Inbound Connection Accepted on World-Open SSH/DB Security Group) OR BIOC(Over-Privileged CSPM IAM Principal Used for Control-Plane Action) — promotes a static CSPM finding to an active incident when the flagged misconfiguration is exercised within the POV window.
rules.name: Cloud Posture-to-Runtime — Flagged Exposure Actively Reached or Abused
